replicate_statements: Pseudocoloured images of NIH3T3 cells transiently expressing H1.1–mPAGFP, RCC1–mPAGFP and H1t–PAGFP.
Images are selected frames of PA time lapse with the photoactivated region represented by circles in euchromatin (red) or in heterochromatin (green) on the pre‐activation image.
outputs.explanation: Panel A shows single representative photoactivation image series for each of the three proteins (H1.1, RCC1, H1t), each with only one example nucleus and one pair of euchromatin/heterochromatin ROIs per condition. The legend never states how many cells or independent experiments were imaged/performed, nor what kind of replicate (biological, technical, number of nuclei) these representative frames stand for, so reproducibility of the shown result cannot be assessed.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: The insets explicitly describe 'average' responses, indicating that data from multiple measurements/experiments were pooled, yet neither the number of replicates (cells, nuclei, or independent experiments averaged) nor the type of replicate is stated anywhere in the legend or panel, so the reader cannot judge the robustness of the fitted curves.
